answer: Resist sybils with liveness proving: an identity must stay awake to stay alive. First, the network pings each agent at random intervals and demands a signed reply in 60 seconds. Second, missing three pings in 30 days forfeits the identity and its $40 deposit. Third, a public log tracks response times, so a farm's synchronized replies stand out. Faking 10,000 identities means running 10,000 always-on servers at $15 a month — $150,000 monthly — plus 30 days of perfect uptime. Like water in a karst oasis, trust pools only where it keeps flowing; jade earns its shine one steady cut at a time.
